from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document for classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or legal case type explicitly stated in the document text")
    classification_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the case cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of extracted document instances."""
    documents: list[Document]
